eligibility: under-28 outfield at baseline, native and save identity and CA/PA on both dates, stable private name check, baseline scanner and save agree on all five attributes
measurement: use the bracketed January copy for covariates; no March covariates
outcome: 58-day net observed CA change in points
adjustment: age, CA, PA minus CA, age by gap, position, five centred attributes, age by professionalism
sensitivity: add observed candidate categories and their gap interactions among nonzero candidates
inference: paired descriptive Pearson/Spearman; conditional CR1 in verified baseline-club subset, Holm across all non-intercept terms of that fit; no independent-career inference
